notes.title: Popular JRPG LiEat is Coming to Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
Dear Users,

The highly popular JRPG LiEat will be available on Nintendo Switch on May 27!

[previewyoutube=jSGk0Pn9n3I;full][/previewyoutube]

Purchase LiEat from the Nintendo eShop on May 27.

On top of optimization for the Switch console, this version of LiEat also comes with five brand new illustrations by developer △○□× (Miwashiba).

[quote=author] Comment from △○□× (Miwashiba):
For LiEat's Switch release, I have created a brand new title screen and made various improvements to the game's design. I'm confident that this new and improved version of LiEat will satisfy new players as well as players who have alredy experienced the game before. Please check LiEat out when it releases on Nintendo Switch and thank you for your support![/quote] 

[h2]Don't miss your chance to win an exclusive illustration with YOUR name on it![/h2]

To commemorate LiEat's Nintendo Switch release, we are offering 5 lucky users the chance to win a very special digital illustration signed by △○□× (Miwashiba), with your name (usernames/nicknames are acceptable) on it!　

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11707363/7396f2cdcb2bdc72b794c82a47a2f8bd5bf2211e.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Follow PLAYISM's official Twitter account [url=https://twitter.com/playismEN]@playismEN[/url]
[*] PLAYISM EN's campaign post
[/list]

5/20 - 5/31 (JST)

[h3]Notes[/h3]

notes.title: [Playism News] Angels of Death Out Now!
notes.content:
To all fans of 2D Horror Adventure games, today Playism has released "Angels of Death" on Playism and Steam! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/537110/

From the creator of the famous horror game "Kirisame ga furu mori" (Forest of Drizzling Rain), comes "Angels of Death" which was released in the Den-fami Nico Game Magazine and is now available worldwide! 
"Angels of Death" is a psycho horror adventure game, which consists of four episodes. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27040821/845b964cb8d9038287c1684734feeaf126fd4806.jpg[/img]

When Ray woke, she was in a concrete room with no memory. After leaving the room, she explored the building, searching for an exit. But she eventually crossed paths with Zack, a murderer whose face is bandaged and bears a resemblance to the Grim Reaper. 

[quote]"Please – kill me." 
"If you help me get outta here, then I'll kill you." [/quote]

The two formed a peculiar bond through their strange "promise" and started to search for an exit to the sealed building together. 
What kind of hell have they found themselves in? For what purpose are they imprisoned? What does fate have in store for them? 

You can get Angels of Death on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/537110/]Steam[/url] and [url=http://playism-games.com/game/307/angels-of-death]Playism![/url]

[h1]We hope you enjoy this tragically beautiful story about a murderer who wants to kill and a girl who wishes to be killed. [/h1]

notes.title: Alicemare coming soon to Steam
notes.content:
[h1]Down the rabbit hole.... [/h1]




From the creator of LiEat comes Alicemare, a dark horror-esque game is coming soon to Steam. 

Allen has arrived at a special facility, with no memories or parents, he soon meets a variety of different children, each with their own story to tell. 

After investigating a strange rumor he heard from the other kids, Allen stumbles down the rabbit hole into a strange world.


Alicemare is coming soon! 


http://store.steampowered.com/app/524850
